react.message: Business and UI .tsx components must not use useEffect/useLayoutEffect (vercel-react-best-practices: rerender-derived-state-no-effect, rerender-move-effect-to-event). Derive state in render, subscribe via useSyncExternalStore, or isolate imperative DOM/Canvas bindings in src/client/dom-hooks.ts.
Shell components must not use useEffect/useLayoutEffect; isolate DOM effects in src/client/dom-hooks.ts.

paths.@a2ui/react: Cold-boot shell (lib/client.js) must never import @a2ui/react; load runtime lazily via src/client/chunk-loader.ts.
paths.echarts: Cold-boot shell (lib/client.js) must never import echarts; load via client.echarts.js.
paths.mermaid: Cold-boot shell (lib/client.js) must never import mermaid; load via client.mermaid.js.
paths.@tanstack/react-table: Cold-boot shell (lib/client.js) must stay lightweight; keep table runtime in client.runtime.js.
paths.react-aria-components: Cold-boot shell (lib/client.js) must stay lightweight; keep widget runtime in client.runtime.js.
paths.zod: Cold-boot shell (lib/client.js) must never import zod.

paths.react: Pure shared/helper modules must remain framework-free and deterministic (no React imports).
paths.react-dom: Pure shared/helper modules must remain framework-free and deterministic (no ReactDOM imports).
paths.echarts: Pure shared/helper modules must not import echarts directly.
paths.mermaid: Pure shared/helper modules must not import mermaid directly.
